items.description: Tidal Thames riverside from Putney Bridge to Teddington Weir
items.eaAreaName: Kent, South London and East Sussex

floodArea.county: Greater London, Hammersmith and Fulham, Hounslow, Richmond upon Thames, Wandsworth

items.message:
High tides today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM on 12/11/2026. 
The forecast high tide at Richmond is 4.74 mAOD at 4:00 PM on Thursday 12th November.

Locations most affected will be Putney Embankment (SW15), Chiswick Mall and Strand on the Green (W4), Thames Bank at Mortlake (SW14), Ranelagh Drive (TW1), Friars Lane and Water Lane (TW9), Riverside and The Embankment at Twickenham, and the Towpath below Teddington Lock. Flooding of properties is not expected.

Astronomical tide levels are falling. The river flow at Teddington Weir is 5 cubic metres per second and is steady. We anticipate the flows to remain steady for the next few days. 
We are closing flood gates . 
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses.   
This message will be updated by 5:30PM on Thursday 12 November or as the situation changes.
